name: Drawer
intent: A panel that slides in from the right edge for a detail view or an edit form about something on the page, while the page stays in view behind it.
usage: Use Drawer to show or edit one record next to the list it came from: a detail view, an edit form, related context. It is one component: pass open, title, onClose and the content as children. size picks the width: narrow 360 for quick views, medium 460 for forms, wide 590 for rich details, extended 1100 for side-by-side work. footer holds kit Buttons, size sm, at the end: secondary first, one primary last. Escape, the close button or a click on the page behind it closes it. For a decision that must block the page, use Modal or AlertDialog. See contracts/drawer.json for the full contract. A portaled panel takes the theme of whatever opened it, so it is dark with a dark app frame even though it is drawn at the end of the page.

title.note: 20px bold (text-title-lg). It names the drawer for screen readers.

description.note: One line under the title. Read with the drawer.

size.note: Width 360 / 460 / 590 / 1100, never wider than the screen. Full height; the body scrolls.

showClose.note: The close button in the header. Escape and a click behind the drawer still close.

onClose.note: () => void. Runs on Escape, the close button, or a click behind the drawer.

children.note: The body: FormDisplay rows, a Form, a Table or text.

footer.note: Kit Buttons, size sm: secondary first, one primary last. A Form inside can put its submit here with the form attribute.

useWhen: Viewing or editing one record while its list stays in view.
Extra context about a selected item, like its history or related records.
doNot: Do not use it for main navigation. Use AppNav.
Do not open a drawer from inside another drawer.
Do not use it for a decision that must block the page. Use Modal or AlertDialog.
Do not invent a Sheet, SidePanel, DrawerHeader or DrawerFooter. Use Drawer.
a11y: role dialog with aria-modal, named by its title and described by description.
On open, focus moves to the first field in the body, else the close button. Tab stays inside; on close, focus goes back to what opened it.
Escape closes it, unless a menu inside handles Escape first. The page behind does not scroll while it is open.
The close button is a kit Button named Close, with a kit Tooltip.
It slides in unless the person prefers reduced motion.
snippet:
<Drawer
  open={open}
  title="Edit contact"
  size="medium"
  onClose={close}
  footer={<>
    <Button size="sm" onClick={close}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button size="sm" variant="primary" type="submit" form="contact">Save</Button>
  </>}
>
  <Form id="contact">…</Form>
</Drawer>

examples.title: Sizes
examples.usage: Open each width: narrow 360, medium 460, wide 590, extended 1100.
